question: Can selector V2 preserve the fixed 80/10 split, 22500 clusters, exact role quotas and full event coverage while representing every tunnel with <=10m same-tunnel arc coverage?
method: For each of 90 graph/spline worlds, solve twice a sparse binary MILP with exact role quotas, exact length-proportional tunnel quotas, junction/terminal event coverage and <=10m coverage of every 5m candidate center; compare against V1 spatial metrics and create ten train-only full-map figures. No mesh, raycast, data export or training.
baseline: The sealed V1 selector output: 22500 clusters with exact role/event quotas but 58 omitted tunnels in 50/90 worlds and maximum represented-tunnel gap 330m.

user_authorization.scope: One zero-ray selector-V2 feasibility implementation and formal audit preserving 80/10 worlds, 22500 clusters, role quotas and event coverage; no data re-export or training.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after being told the recommended next action was a zero-ray selector-V2 feasibility audit and its no-export/no-training boundary.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly 80 train and 10 validation graph/spline worlds provide 27247 candidates and exactly 22500 selected clusters; C10 and M-TARE reads are zero.
Every world exactly matches frozen interior/junction/terminal quotas and deterministic length-proportional per-tunnel quotas.
Every tunnel is represented, all 634 junction and 575 terminal events are covered, and every candidate center is <=10m arc distance from a selected center on the same tunnel.
Two independent MILP solves per world return identical selected IDs and metrics.
Ten train-only full-map spatial figures show V1 versus V2 gap/missing metrics; validation/test previews are zero.
Complete within 600 seconds and 100MiB with metrics, manifest, logs, RUN_STATE and seal; mesh loads, rays, data export, training and models remain zero.
stop_conditions: Any source/tool/seal, split, count, role, tunnel quota, event, coverage, replay, visualization, time or disk check fails.
Any threshold relaxation, new world/seed/candidate, mesh/raycast, data export, training or M-TARE change is required.
expected_evidence: 22500-line selector-V2 cluster manifest, 90 world metrics and aggregate V1→V2 comparison.
Ten train-only recipe spatial figures with coordinates, roles, old gap/missing count and V2 gap.
Frozen proposal/spec/source identity, raw log, RUN_STATE and complete SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only SciPy MILP over graph/spline candidates; zero mesh, raycast, simulator, GPU, data export or training.
